transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions blind; we need to understand true prevalence, spread, and severity immediately.

actions.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions blind; we need to understand true prevalence, spread, and severity immediately.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Supply chains for PPE, tests, and ventilators take weeks to ramp; we must act now before any surge overwhelms hospitals.

actions.rationale: Supply chains for PPE, tests, and ventilators take weeks to ramp; we must act now before any surge overwhelms hospitals.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has long lead times; every week of delay costs lives if this proves severe.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutic development has long lead times; every week of delay costs lives if this proves severe.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Honest, data-driven communication builds the public trust we will need if tougher measures become necessary later.

actions.rationale: Honest, data-driven communication builds the public trust we will need if tougher measures become necessary later.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, low-disruption intervention that reduces transmission regardless of the virus's true severity.

actions.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, low-disruption intervention that reduces transmission regardless of the virus's true severity.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: Transparent national data aligns governors, hospitals, and the public around shared facts rather than rumors.

actions.rationale: Transparent national data aligns governors, hospitals, and the public around shared facts rather than rumors.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Early financial cushioning prevents cascading business failures and gives households the security to comply with any future measures.

actions.rationale: Early financial cushioning prevents cascading business failures and gives households the security to comply with any future measures.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Sustained response requires statutory authority and appropriations; early bipartisan engagement prevents later gridlock.

actions.rationale: Sustained response requires statutory authority and appropriations; early bipartisan engagement prevents later gridlock.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.3 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 103/100. Public trust 57/100. Hospital strain 5/100. Restriction level 0.2/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Slowing importation of new cases buys time to learn more about severity without domestic economic disruption.

actions.rationale: Slowing importation of new cases buys time to learn more about severity without domestic economic disruption.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: If this proves severe, the elderly and high-risk will bear the worst outcomes; targeted protections now save lives at low societal cost.

actions.rationale: If this proves severe, the elderly and high-risk will bear the worst outcomes; targeted protections now save lives at low societal cost.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Continued honest communication maintains public trust and explains why we're being measured rather than alarmist or dismissive.

actions.rationale: Continued honest communication maintains public trust and explains why we're being measured rather than alarmist or dismissive.

actions.name: defer_to_states

params.rationale: With no deaths and low hospital strain, governors are best positioned to calibrate local responses to their specific conditions.

actions.rationale: With no deaths and low hospital strain, governors are best positioned to calibrate local responses to their specific conditions.

Economy index 104/100. Public trust 59/100. Hospital strain 6/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 58/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Multi-state seeding from a single event demands expanded genomic surveillance to track transmission chains and identify emerging hotspots.

actions.rationale: Multi-state seeding from a single event demands expanded genomic surveillance to track transmission chains and identify emerging hotspots.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With wider geographic spread, nursing homes and high-risk settings face greater exposure; targeted protections prevent the worst outcomes if severity proves high.

actions.rationale: With wider geographic spread, nursing homes and high-risk settings face greater exposure; targeted protections prevent the worst outcomes if severity proves high.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: The superspreader event will generate fear and misinformation; honest communication about what we know and don't know maintains the trust we've built.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Reinforcing the mask mandate and extending it to indoor public spaces addresses the superspreader dynamic without economic shutdown.

actions.rationale: Reinforcing the mask mandate and extending it to indoor public spaces addresses the superspreader dynamic without economic shutdown.
